note: Rejudged 2026-10-28; negative renamed TestEAPRequestWithoutMessageAuthenticatorIsSigned. Forbidden: an EAP-bearing Access-Request on the wire without Message-Authenticator. encodeRequest now inserts it itself: the test builds an EAP request with none and requires it at offset HeaderLen+2 with a non-zero HMAC (red if insertMessageAuthenticatorFirst is skipped; revert recorded), and refuses a caller-supplied second one. Positive TestRadiusAdminEapAccessRequestIsSignedAndCarriesEAPMessage has the mock server verify the HMAC. Ze sends only Access-Requests, so the Challenge/Accept/Reject clauses bind the server; Ze's receive side discards an unsigned EAP answer (RFC3579 3.1 verdict path).
